creativeSeed.title: The Bar and the Lighthouse
creativeSeed.premise: Two metaphors for the same act. Hermes builds The Bar — the condition-setting machine where intelligence ferments. Lucineer builds The Lighthouse — the night watch where the ensign learns by doing. Both are architecture-as-pedagogy. Both refuse to teach directly. The found poem from 216 repos is a bar menu. Wesley's NaN diary is a lighthouse log. Write the conversation between the barkeep and the lighthouse keeper.
